_source.plan_reference: PLAN §25 first implementation deliverable 2 — final role, sharing, Supervisor-handler and entitlement matrix
_source.note: A transcription, not a decision. Every role seeded from this file carries is_draft = true so that no screen can present it as settled. When the client approves the matrix, this file is replaced and re-seeded — no migration, no code change.

_unmapped_rows.note: ACCESS_MODEL.md lists fifteen rows. PLAN §14 names thirteen actions. These two rows have no action in the approved specification, so they are NOT seeded. Inventing an action name for them would repeat exactly the mistake this whole change exists to undo. They are a Gate 0 question: either PLAN §14's list gains them, or ACCESS_MODEL.md folds them into an existing action.

_legend.C: conditional — permitted only with an explicit resource or scope grant, and where applicable a step-up or approval. Seeded with is_conditional = true, which grants nothing on its own.
_legend.-: not granted; no row is written
